sources.title: OpenModelDB
sources.snippet: OpenModelDB is a community driven database of AI Upscaling models. We aim to provide a better way to find and compare models than existing sources.

sources.snippet: Some models advertise benefits for supported clients such as Codex or Claude Code. Model Pricing shows currently published offers, while the consumption log shows the price actually applied to a request. Learn more in Client Benefits.
